description.value: Seymour Art Gallery is a free, non-profit public gallery established in 1985 and the only public gallery in the District of North Vancouver, situated in the heart of Deep Cove — a hugely popular cycling destination. The gallery welcomes over 26,000 visitors annually to a rotating schedule of visual arts exhibitions, performance events, and public programs. It shares the Deep Cove Cultural Centre building with several other arts organizations, making it a natural cultural stop at the end of a scenic ride.
